title.en: Kao Dake Seijo na no ni, Shi ni Modottara Reikoku Datta Koushaku-sama no Hon'ne ga Ama Sugimasu!
Zense Seijo datta Watashi wa Kusushi ni narimashita
Oshi ni Muchuu na Tensei Heroine desu ga, Mishiranu Momoiru Yurufuwa Ouji ni Dekiai Kouryakusareteimasu
Ane no Migawari de Konyaku shitara Naze ka Henkyou no Seijo to Yobareru you ni narimashita
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara, Juuna Ouji ni Kyuukon saremashita
Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu
Kyou kara Akujo ni narimasu! Tsukaisute no Migawari Seijo Nante Gomen desu
Meryoku no nai Otaku Reijou wa, Jiki Koushaku-sama no Ichizu na Dekiai ni Honrousareru
Usso, Koushaku Reijou wo Oshinokete Ouji no Konyaku-sha (Kari) ni Natta Onna ni Tensei?
Akugyaku Seijo desu ga, Aisuru Danna-sama no Oyaku ni Tachitai desu. (To wa Ie, Kirawarete Iru no desu ga)
Make Heroine ni Tensei Shitara Seijo ni Narimashita
Tsuihousareta Moto Reijou, Mori de Hirotta Ouji ni Dekiaisare Seijo ni Mezameru
Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~
Konyaku Haki Sareta Kaedama Reijou, Hatsukoi no Toshiue Ouji ni Dekiai Sareru
Kurotou no Nemureru Majutsushi Toraware no Musume to Shirarezaru Kinjutsu
Koukai suru Nara Gokatte ni ~Anata no Eranda Seijo-sama to Douzo wo Shiawase ni~
Konyaku Haki wa Honmou desu! Seijo no Chikara ga Kaika Shita no de Watashi wa Jiyuu ni Kurashimasu - Honmono no Seijou wa Gishi de wa Naku Watashi deshita
